lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Hahaha.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Hahahahahahahahahahahaha.
Why are you laughing?

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Cause I'm so happy!

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Did you see the music charts?
Not yet.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Do you even realize how many weeks I've been at the top?

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Number one for eight weeks running, baby!
Is that good?

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: About 50 songs get made per week.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: You do the math.
Wow.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Isn't it amazing?

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Amongst all those songs,

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: I'm at the top of the heap.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Not even Noise could pull that off.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: My music is the most popular around.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Now, do you see how amazing my music is?

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: If I'm being honest, this song is a masterpiece.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Although I'm sure you haven't heard it yet, right?
I'll listen to it right now.
I've heard it.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Are you kidding me? It's already been out for...

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: What did you think?
Erm...

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Hey! Be honest! Have you really listened to my music before?
... Sorry.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: What kind of a lousy manager are you, anyway?

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: I ought to fire you right here and now.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Make sure you listen to all my albums by tomorrow.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Every single one, from my debut until now. Is that clear?
Crystal.
